title: Cylinder
spec: To construct a cylindrical object, start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, create the first loop by drawing a circle with a center at coordinates (0.0078, 0.0078) and a radius of 0.0078. For the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a radius of 0.0072. After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.0156 to the entire sketch. Ensure that the scaled sketch is rotated using the Euler angles set to zero degrees and translated using the translation vector set to zero. To transform the two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch along its normal by 0.75 units, without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate this new part with the previous body by creating a new solid body. The resulting cylindrical object will have a uniform diameter and a smooth surface, with flat and parallel top and bottom surfaces. The dimensions of the cylinder will be 0.015625 units in length, 0.015625 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0078, 0.0078)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0078)         # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0072)         # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Outer diameter 0.0156, so outer radius = 0.0078
# Tube appears hollow (TOP view shows a small circle with inner detail)
outer_r = 0.0078
inner_r = 0.0050
length = 0.75

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_r)
    .circle(inner_r)
    .extrude(length)
)

import cadquery as cq

# Simple cylindrical rod
# Diameter from bounding box X/Y: 0.0156, length along Z: 0.75
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(0.0156 / 2.0)
    .extrude(0.75)
)
